purpose: Second-compaction boundary for the 0062 contract: a new snapcompact archive that folds and replaces a standing one must be admitted when the reader's frame price makes it a net reduction, rejected when the same archive is priced at the cross-shape ceiling, and admitted only because the pre-compaction baseline credits the standing summary.

incident.source: patches/PATCHES.md §0045 failure signature (session 01a06d18-8d5b, gpt-6-astra on a hand-written gateway, api=openai-responses)

derivation: Synthetic by construction: the probe renders the fixture's text from a seeded PRNG over a fixed vocabulary and writes its own session. No live session file is copied.
Frames, kept tail and ceiling price are the incident's: standing archive 10 frames, successor 18 frames, kept tail 21 665 tokens, and the ceiling bill 18 x 5 024 = 90 432 per successor archive.

The archived region is derived, not pinned: 108 000 characters -> ~32 000 tokens. With N standing frames and F successor frames the guard's two decisions are (F-N) x shapePrice < region <= F x shapePrice, so the region must sit inside the frame-growth window; the incident's 63 729 tokens is above F x shapePrice = 18 x 3 136 = 56 448, where the credit stops being load-bearing and no control can attribute it. 32 019 sits inside 8 x 3 136 = 25 088 and 56 448 with >= 25% margin on each side.

Region <= (region capacity / ceiling price) x regionTokens is what makes the ceiling leg reject at all: the archive is cheaper than the text it replaces only while the text is denser than 13 916 / 5 024 = 2.77 chars/token, and cheaper at the shape price while it is denser than 13 916 / 3 136 = 4.44. This vocabulary prices at ~3.4 chars/token in the probe's reader, between the two.

summaryCeilingTokens is measured, not pinned: the incident's 98 757 = 8 325 text + 90 432 frames, and 8 325 tokens of summary text only appears in a session whose summary carries a long FILES / earlier-summary lead. This fixture's summary template bills ~242 tokens by the probe's tokenizer and ~16 000 by the session tokenizer (the two readers price this vocabulary differently), so the fixture pins only the frame bill and the decisions.

Token pins below are documentation of the boundary, not part of the verdict: the probe records them and fails only on a wrong decision, a wrong committed frame count, a wrong frame price, or a provider request.
